summary: Authored a 6-phase implementation plan (~6.75h, waves [[1,2,3],[4,5],[6]]) that formalizes the already-universal **Files to modify** per-phase convention in plan-format.md, builds a single shared plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, widens update-task-status.sh's existing --file-scope-add union-merge to accept plan postflight, wires the harvest into all FOUR plan-postflight call sites (orchestrator-postflight.sh, reconcile-task-status.sh x2, skill-reviser/SKILL.md), and adds a dry-run/idempotent cross-repo backfill that reuses the harvester. All dispatch DECIDE items are resolved in a dedicated Decisions section: union not overwrite; revisions do re-harvest; harvest failure is a non-fatal warning; field documented required with validator gating deferred; Scope Hypothesis is not a harvest source; plan-less tasks are left absent (no inference, no [] sentinel).

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: formalize **Files to modify** in plan-format.md, build plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, widen --file-scope-add to plan postflight, wire all four call sites, add cross-repo backfill, deploy and verify.
